Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		request: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = id)
	precondition:
		request.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let addOb: ApprovalLetter in
		addOb.oclIsNew() and
		addOb.Content = 'ApprovalLetterContent' and
		request.AttachedApprovalLetter = addOb and
		CurrentApprovalLetter = addOb and
		CurrentLoanRequest = request and
		result = true
}
